abstract.p: This paper describes our participation in the DravidianLangTech@NAACL 2025 shared task on hate speech detection in Dravidian languages. While the task provided both text transcripts and audio data, we demonstrate that competitive results can be achieved using text features alone. We employed fine-tuned Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) models from l3cubepune for Malayalam, Tamil, and Telugu languages. Our system achieved notable results, securing first position for Telugu, and second position for Tamil and Malayalam tasks in the official leaderboard.
